content: In this paper we propose equation embeddings (EqEmb), an unsupervised approach for learning distributed representations of equations. The idea is to treat the equation as a "singleton word," one that appears once but that appears in the context of other words. The surrounding text of the equation—and in particular, the distributed representations of that text—provides the data we need to develop a useful representation of the equation.
